detail.name: The First Safehouse
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Beyond Dreams of the Past
detail.desc2:
A card with Komano Manato's personal photo printed on it.
"This safehouse was the first shelter I set up for myself when I was eight."
"Even though I used to say silly stuff like 'I don't need any friends,' somehow... I think I still believed I'd be sharing this place with someone one day."
"Looks like I've got some bandages left from before. Proxy, hold on, I'll patch this up real quick... ngh!"
